authority_rules: planner selects plan only; runner owns mission execution state
runtime gateway owns execution-job enqueue/get transport only
execution runtime executes one already-authorized model route
device gateway owns device transport only
verification is evidence authority, not execution authority
legacy functions are never canonical execution authorities
retirement_rule: remove legacy from deploy consumers first; deactivate only after consumer audit

rollback.rule: rollback only the failed canonical stage; never promote a legacy stage implicitly
